14→15: Caching no longer default for fetch
15→16: Node.js 20.9+ and TypeScript 5.1+ minimum; Node.js 18 no longer supported
Turbopack is the default bundler for dev and build (opt out with `next dev --webpack` / `next build --webpack`)
Cache Components: explicit opt-in caching via the `use cache` directive and `cacheComponents: true` (replaces `experimental.dynamicIO`); all dynamic code runs at request time by default
`experimental.ppr` flag and `export const experimental_ppr` removed (superseded by Cache Components)
`middleware.ts` deprecated in favour of `proxy.ts` (runs on the Node.js runtime)
`revalidateTag(tag)` now requires a cacheLife profile as the second argument for stale-while-revalidate; new `updateTag()` and `refresh()` Server Action APIs
AMP support removed; `next lint` removed (use ESLint or Biome directly)
`serverRuntimeConfig` / `publicRuntimeConfig` removed (use env vars); `experimental.turbopack` moved to top-level `turbopack`
Parallel routes now require explicit `default.js` files
next/image defaults changed (minimumCacheTTL 4h, qualities [75], stricter local-IP and redirect handling); `images.domains` deprecated for `images.remotePatterns`
